subject: Executive briefing: locking CTO & VP presence — fallback and coverage plan
messages:
From: Anna Peters <anna.peters@aerodynamix.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-27T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to lock CTO + VP for exec briefing (60m)

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the quick runthrough last week. AeroDynamiX is very interested — before we move the PoC forward our CTO (Michael Chen) and VP Product (Laura Simmons) would like a 60-minute exec-level briefing/demo focused on integration risks and data governance.

Proposed windows (all ET):
- Tue Nov 2, 14:00–15:00 ET
- Wed Nov 3, 10:00–11:00 ET
- Thu Nov 4, 16:00–17:00 ET

Can you confirm whether Redwood can guarantee CTO or senior engineering presence? If not, please provide a named backup who can speak to architecture and security. We also need a short agenda and any pre-read. I attached our exec priorities doc.

Appreciate it — Anna

Attachment: AeroDynamiX_exec_priorities.docx (document stub)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Peters <anna.peters@aerodynamix.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-28T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to lock CTO + VP for exec briefing (60m)

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear windows and the priorities doc. We're excited to run this.

Quick answers:
- We can commit to a senior engineering presence for the briefing. I've tentatively held Tue Nov 2, 14:00–15:00 ET on Jasmine Liu's calendar.
- Our CTO (Vivek Kulkarni) is requested for the call; if he is pulled into an urgent incident we will have Karthik Iyer (Head of Solutions Architecture) act as named technical lead.

Attached is a draft 60m agenda and a one-page pre-read (see Redwood-demo-agenda.pdf). Proposed agenda: 10m intro + 25m architecture & integration + 15m security/data governance + 10m next steps.

Can you confirm which of the three windows you prefer so we can lock calendars and request Vivek's confirmation? If you need a recording we can enable that but would prefer to keep the session private to execs — open to your guidance.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0172

Attachment: Redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Anna Peters <anna.peters@aerodynamix.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@aerodynamix.com>, eng-ops@aerodynamix.com
Date: 2026-10-28T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to lock CTO + VP for exec briefing (60m)

Jasmine — thanks for the quick turnaround and the agenda.

Nov 2 at 14:00 ET works best for the execs. Michael asked if you can nudge his EA for a hard confirmation — she coordinates his calendar and he is likely to accept but wants a calendar hold, not a public recording. If you could also share a brief (2–3 bullets) on the data retention and key management topics in advance, that would be helpful.

I'll mark Nov 2, 14:00–15:00 ET as preferred and will confirm with Michael's EA shortly.

Anna

Attachment: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Peters <anna.peters@aerodynamix.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to lock CTO + VP for exec briefing (60m)

Hi Anna and Jasmine — thanks for the sync. I can confirm Karthik will be available as technical lead if Vivek is pulled away; I'll prepare a short architecture runbook and a 3-bullet summary on KM + retention for pre-read.

Next actions I will take:
- Post pre-read (KM + retention bullets) to your shared link and send to Michael's EA (please provide contact if you have it).
- Hold Nov 2, 14:00–15:00 ET on my calendar as backup.

If Michael confirms he will attend, Vivek will join the first 40m and we will hand off to Karthik for detailed Q&A.

-Karthik
Head of Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Laura Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anna Peters <anna.peters@aerodynamix.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to lock CTO + VP for exec briefing (60m)

Putting a quick note here: I'll be Laura's point for customer success coverage and will join the tail end to cover next steps / any procurement questions. If Michael can't join we should still run the session focused on integration — he can get a short summary afterwards.

—Laura

From: Anna Peters <anna.peters@aerodynamix.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-03T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to lock CTO + VP for exec briefing (60m)

Thanks all — Michael's EA confirmed the hold for Nov 2, 14:00–15:00 ET. We'll keep the session private (no recording) and expect Vivek for the first 40 minutes. Laura — great to have you for next steps. Looking forward to the agenda and the KM bullets.

Anna

--
Anna Peters
Dir. Platform Strategy | AeroDynamiX
anna.peters@aerodynamix.com
+1 617-555-0241
snippet: Locking Nov 2 14:00 ET for exec briefing; Vivek requested, Karthik named backup; pre-read and KM bullets to be provided.
